"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from . import audit
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def issue_credit_note(invoice, amount, reason, *, idempotency_key=None):
    """Credit part of an issued invoice back to the customer.

    ``amount`` must be positive and must not exceed the invoice total. Only
    issued invoices can be credited. When ``idempotency_key`` is supplied, a
    prior credit note recorded under the same key is returned instead of
    issuing a duplicate.
    """
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("credit_note_issued"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return {
                    "invoice_id": entry["invoice_id"],
                    "amount": entry["amount"],
                    "reason": entry["reason"],
                }

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    total = invoice_total(invoice)
    if amount > total:
        raise BillingError("amount_exceeds_total", f"{amount} > {total}")
    if not reason:
        raise BillingError("reason_required", "a reason is required")

    note = {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "reason": reason}
    audit.record("credit_note_issued", idempotency_key=idempotency_key, **note)
    return note

from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def authorize(payment_id: str, invoice: Invoice, amount, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record("payment_authorized", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment
=== promotions.py ===
"""Promotion campaigns (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from datetime import datetime

CAMPAIGNS = {"black-friday": {"percent": 30, "ends": datetime(2025, 12, 1)}}


def campaign_percent(name: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> int:
    campaign = CAMPAIGNS.get(name)
    if campaign is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown campaign {name!r}")
    now = now or datetime.now()
    return campaign["percent"] if now < campaign["ends"] else 0

from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, Payment
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def authorize(payment_id: str, invoice: Invoice, amount, at: datetime) -> Payment:
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")
    payment = Payment(id=payment_id, invoice_id=invoice.id, amount=amount, created_at=ensure_utc(at))
    audit.record("payment_authorized", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment

    return campaign["percent"] if now < campaign["ends"] else 0
